d:
short, spiked, ash-blonde hair with long bangs swept to the side. sharp, narrow, pale blue eyes with a cold expression. appears to be in early adulthood with a mature, stern face. slender, athletic build. a high-collared white tunic under a dark navy blue sleeveless cloak, accented by silver metallic plates on the shoulders. a long, silver-hilted rapier strapped to the waist.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
